english.title: Refuse / wilfully neglect to furnish information / produce document required under section 190 notice
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) refused or wilfully neglected to

(A)_[furnish information, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION REQUIRED..) which you were required to furnish]_
(B)_[produce a document, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT REQUIRED..) which you were required to produce]_

by a notice under section 190 of the Employment Rights Act 1996
english.legislation: Contrary to section 190(3) of the Employment Rights Act 1996.
